## Professional Overview
Mirza Uzaif Baig is an AI & ML Engineer and Full Stack Developer based in Kalaburagi, Karnataka. He builds intelligent software systems, computer vision pipelines, multi-page business applications, and automated workflows. He is the founder and solo operator of UB Web Care (ubwebcare.studio), a registered MSME studio (UDYAM-KR-15-0071676) helping small businesses, clinics, retail shops, and startups establish a fast, high-converting digital presence.
